name: org_graph_add_level
description: Add a level to the bottom of the Org Graph's taxonomy, from effective_on (today by default). Espalia holds the new level. parent_ids lists the level_ids it can sit under (by default, every level above it), and top whether it can sit at the top (by default, only when parent_ids is empty, or when neither is given). org_graph_set_kind_parents changes these later. Level names are unique, ignoring case, within a structure. structure_unit_id adds the type to that unit's own structure instead of the top one. The organisation's structure needs a tenant admin or an Org Graph editor; a unit's own structure also admits an owner of that unit or a unit above it, and anyone above them in the reporting line.

parent_ids.description: level_ids the new level can sit under

structure_unit_id.description: a unit with a structure of its own, to change its unit types; the organisation's structure by default
